vacuum-editor.image_helper: A camera or an image entity (camera.robot_map), or a picture’s address (/local/floor.png)
vacuum-editor.calibration_helper: Empty: the map entity’s own. image: the picture’s own pixels (a floor plan). Or an entity that holds it; three or four points go in YAML
vacuum-editor.rooms_helper: Empty: the rooms the map’s entity says. In YAML: id, name, outline, area, color
vacuum-editor.action_helper: Your own action, in YAML. [[selection]], [[point_x]], [[point_y]] and [[repeats]] become the numbers picked on the map
vacuum-editor.zone_helper: Four numbers, as the robot counts: [x1, y1, x2, y2]
vacuum-editor.zones_helper: A list of zones, four numbers each: [[x1, y1, x2, y2]]
vacuum-editor.preset_rooms_helper: The rooms’ numbers, as the robot counts them: [16, 17]
vacuum-editor.point_helper: Two numbers, [x, y]: the robot goes there
vacuum-editor.preset_tap_helper: Empty: it cleans what it names. An action of your own takes its numbers as [[selection]], [[point_x]], [[point_y]] and [[repeats]], or those picked on the map where it names none
vacuum-editor.preset_hold_helper: Empty: it is shown on the map
